title: An Attempt to Prove the Motion of the Earth from Observations
lineage: Mapped excerpt of Hooke’s 1674 published tract. It does not explicitly state the later 1680 inverse-square proposal.

passages.note: Printed pp. 27–28 / source PDF pp. 43–44: celestial attraction, inertial tangential motion and changing attraction with distance.

file.method: Selected pages extracted without changing page content using pdfseparate/pdfunite; corresponding raster renders were compared to the complete source section. Source page numbers count the source PDF from one.
